product_family: BoldTrail/kvCORE: all-in-one real estate CRM platform combining IDX website, lead engine, AI-powered CRM, marketing automation, listing/transaction management, and business intelligence. Rebranded from kvCORE to BoldTrail in June 2024.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1 or 2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of SOC 2 certification found on vendor's official domain, privacy policy, terms of service, or public marketing materials.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification found on vendor's official domain, privacy policy, terms of service, or public marketing materials.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Terms of Service (Sec. 3.6): 'you agree that you will not (i) use any of the services provided hereunder to collect or otherwise process personal data subject to European data protection laws and regulations, including the European Union's General Data Protection Regulation.' Platform prohibits EU personal data processing by design.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA compliance or Business Associate Agreement (BAA) support. Product is designed for real estate, not healthcare.

certifications.name: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act)
certifications.proof_quote: Terms of Service (Sec. 3.7): 'you agree to comply with all applicable requirements of all applicable state data protection and data privacy laws and regulations of the United States, including but not limited to the California Consumer Privacy Act'; IRE is positioned as a CCPA 'service provider'. Privacy policy exposes a verbatim 'Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information' link and a 'CCPA Privacy Notice'.

certifications.name: PIPEDA (Canada)
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy policy 'Canada Privacy Rights' section: 'under PIPEDA and substantially similar provincial privacy legislation, users also have the right to...' including 'Access their personal information at free or minimal cost within 30 days of requesting access', 'The right to withdraw consent to the processing of personal information', and 'The right to request the deletion of their personal data'.

privacy.ai_training_note: BoldTrail platform includes AI-powered CRM features, but no public documentation on customer data training practices. Privacy policy does not address AI model training on customer data.
privacy.data_region: United States (data stored and processed in US; no international data residency options mentioned)

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: Mentioned for third-party integrations (e.g., Plaid bank verification: 'information is encrypted and securely tokenized'). General encryption standards not publicly documented.

security.name: SLA / Uptime Guarantee
security.value: 24/7 availability target stated, but no specific SLA percentage provided. Excludes planned downtime and circumstances beyond reasonable control.

security.name: Breach Notification
security.value: Commitment to notify 'without undue delay' but no specific timeline defined.

security.name: Vulnerability Disclosure Policy
security.value: Accepts vulnerability submissions from users; specific process not publicly detailed.

security.name: Personnel Confidentiality
security.value: Personnel handling data must be bound by confidentiality obligations.

products.name: BoldTrail (formerly kvCORE)
products.data_scope: Real estate agent/broker contact databases, property listings, client communications, marketing campaigns, transaction management
products.notes: All-in-one front office platform combining IDX website builder, lead engine, AI-powered CRM, marketing automation, listing management, transaction tracking, and business intelligence. Rebranded June 2024. US-only (GDPR-prohibited).

products.name: Kunversion+ (legacy product)
products.data_scope: Lead generation, contact management, customer relationship management
products.notes: Predecessor product; Inside Real Estate portfolio. Targets individual agents, teams, and small-to-medium brokerages.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription-based; tiered pricing for agents and teams
compare.data_residency: United States only; no multi-region or data residency options; GDPR compliance not available

flags: No SOC 2, ISO 27001, or other industry-standard security certifications present or publicly documented.

GDPR compliance explicitly prohibited in terms of service: vendor states 'customers cannot process EU personal data through the platform.' Not suitable for international deployments involving EU data.

No dedicated trust center or security/compliance documentation page found. Security commitments relegate to generic 'commercially reasonable' language in terms of service rather than verifiable standards.
Encryption and technical security details not publicly documented; only general statement of 'industry-standard' protections.
No SLA percentages specified despite uptime claims; breach notification timelines not defined ('without undue delay' is vague).
Product includes AI-powered CRM features but no public policy on whether customer data is used for AI model training.
Real estate industry focus means low probability of HIPAA use cases, but vendor does not explicitly disclose HIPAA ineligibility.
